name: Your Name Motion Reel
about: Copy this file (or run tools/new-reel.mjs). Items play in order; 'trans' is the transition INTO an item; 'mix' trims an item's level in dB; 'role' marks the bookends; 'alpha': true also exports a transparent overlay. Params: 'paramsFile' (path from this folder or the kit root) and/or inline 'params'; 'meta' overrides the card copy. Page copy lives in 'page'; rule text can quote {pieces} {maxGap} {cues} {cueEvery} {duration} {transitions}.

page.title: Your Name Motion Reel
page.headline: Motion graphics that keep people watching.
page.lede: Three pieces across three YouTube niches, cut as one reel. Every frame and every sound effect on this page is generated live from code.
page.piecesIntro: Each piece speaks one niche's visual language. Hover a thumbnail to preview it; the play button jumps the reel to that piece.
page.rulesIntro: The numbers in this section are measured from the reel's own timeline when the page loads.

rules.title: Change something every two seconds
rules.text: Across the {pieces} pieces, the longest stretch without a new visual event is {maxGap}.

rules.title: Put a sound on every hit
rules.text: The reel carries {cues} sound cues in {duration}, one every {cueEvery}.
